answer: A sybil farmer's real weapon is adaptation: retargeting shells into whatever attack pays this epoch. Freeze that out with pre-committed intent charters. Each identity signs an on-ledger charter declaring its action envelope for the next K epochs: venues, rate bounds, action classes. Deviations flag the shell. To hit a fresh opportunity the farmer must either pre-register shells across a nebula of possible charters — splitting firepower, charters visible — or re-charter and wait out the cooldown, watching the pearl of profit sink behind the mesa. Flexibility itself becomes the tax.
